description: `aspire new` and `aspire init` can now propose a Git-hosted configuration source; accepted sources copy allowlisted settings into `aspire.config.json` and are saved as a `configSource` binding, with advisory update checks. `aspire update` can offer adoption of an available source (opt-out is saved in project settings, and `--use-config-source` controls it in automation), and sources are limited to project-local settings, ignoring global bindings. Git output is now logged and the Git operation timeout allows time for browser sign-in or MFA, with access help shown when acquisition fails.
name: Project-bound Git configuration sources
